entry.question: Formalize a finite one-dimensional periodic lattice with sites ZMod N, N positive, real positions and momenta, strictly positive site masses, the forward difference operator D q i = q (i+1) - q i, and basic finite-sum identities. Prove only finite-dimensional algebraic facts. Use Mathlib and inspect Physlib.CondensedMatter.LatticeModels.Basic for reusable grounded definitions; do not assume thermalization or localization.
